instructions: The branch has merge conflicts (see `**branch**` above). Resolve them before committing.
Commit any remaining conflict-resolution changes and push to the PR head branch before review mutations.
Journal key decisions or rejections with URLs or IDs: `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`

`$DISMISS_MESSAGE`: one sentence on what changed. Run even if no code changed: `pr-shepherd apply review https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 --reply-thread-ids PRRT_conflict_thread --message "$DISMISS_MESSAGE" --require-sha HEAD`
